claim: If two adjacent finite attention densities are related by the actual successor *-algebra embedding on the dyadic matrix tower, then the selected-stage weighted-trace linear functionals they induce on the algebraic direct-limit carrier are equal.

carrier.type: MatrixStage k = Matrix (Fin (2^k)) (Fin (2^k)) ℂ and Carrier = DirectLimit MatrixStage rawMap
operations: full complex matrix multiplication and star
selected-stage normalized weighted trace extended by the algebraic direct-limit universal map
conventions: selectedStageFunctional uses A * D as the weighted trace argument
logits are duplicated along the added Fin 2 coordinate

    (logits : Fin (2 ^ k) → ℝ) (β : ℝ) :

        (attentionStageDensity (k + 1) (liftLogits k logits) β) =
      selectedStageColimitFunctional k (attentionStageDensity k logits β) := by
  exact selectedStageColimitFunctional_succ_eq k
    (attentionStageDensity k logits β)
    (attentionStageDensity (k + 1) (liftLogits k logits) β)
    (attentionStageDensity_lift_compatible k logits β)
